tasks.Calculate_Sum_of_Sides: Sum the lengths of all sides to understand the perimeter.
tasks.Determine_Internal_Angles: Since it's an equiangular octagon, each internal angle is 135 degrees. Use this information for further calculations.
tasks.Divide_Octagon_into_Trapezoids: Divide the octagon into trapezoids and calculate their areas separately.
tasks.Sum_Areas_of_Trapezoids: Add up the areas of all trapezoids to get the total area of the octagon.
